# Express Employment Professionals

> Express Employment Professionals is a comprehensive staffing and employment solutions platform connecting job seekers with employers through temporary and permanent placement services.

Express Employment Professionals (EEP) operates as a nationwide staffing agency with office locations across the United States, offering job search services, workforce management, employee benefits, and employer recruitment solutions. The platform includes dedicated portals for job seekers, employees, and employers to streamline the hiring and employment process.

## Key Topics

- Job Search
- Staffing Solutions

## Core Platforms & Portals

- [Express Employment Professionals Homepage](https://www.expresspros.com): Main site for job seekers and employers with job search and staffing solutions
- [Job Application Portal](https://apply.expresspros.com): Employee portal and job application platform for Express Pros staffing
- [Workforce Management Portal](https://workforce.expresspros.com): Workforce management portal for employee account and document access

## Job Seekers & Employment Services

- [Find A New Job](https://www.expresspros.com/job-seekers): Job search and employment services for job seekers at Express Employment
- [Job Search Platform](https://www.expresspros.com/job-seekers/job-seekers): Job search platform and hiring process for Express Employment job seekers
- [Types of Jobs](https://www.expresspros.com/job-seekers/types-of-jobs): Guide to job types and work assignments available through Express Employment
- [The Hiring Process](https://www.expresspros.com/job-seekers/hiring-process): How-to guide for the hiring process at Express Employment Professionals
- [Career Development](https://www.expresspros.com/job-seekers/career-development): Career development resources including ExpressLearn and professional development
- [Job Opportunity Integrity](https://www.expresspros.com/job-seekers/job-opportunity-integrity): Job scam protection guide and fraud prevention for Express job seekers

## Employee Resources & Benefits

- [Associate Resources](https://www.expresspros.com/associates): Forms, W-2 information, and resources for Express Employment associates

- [Express Associate Benefits](https://www.expresspros.com/job-seekers/employee-benefits): Benefits guide for Express Employment Professionals associates and employees
- [Associate Benefits Guide](https://www.expresspros.com/associates/benefits): Comprehensive benefits guide for Express Employment Professionals associates
